description: Technical domain knowledge for role-specific interview question generation

domains.name: Frontend / Web Development
topics: Component architecture and state management (React/Vue/Angular)
Browser rendering performance and optimization (lazy loading, code splitting, virtual DOM)
TypeScript: generics, type guards, advanced patterns
CSS layout systems: Flexbox, Grid, responsive design
Web APIs: Fetch, WebSocket, Service Workers, Web Storage
Testing: unit testing with Jest/Vitest, E2E with Playwright/Cypress
Build tooling: Webpack, Vite, bundler configuration
Accessibility (ARIA, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation)
Security: XSS, CSRF, Content Security Policy
Design systems and component libraries
common_question_patterns: How do you handle state management in large React applications?
Explain the virtual DOM and when it becomes a performance bottleneck.
How would you optimize the initial load time of a web application?
What's your approach to writing accessible web interfaces?

domains.name: Backend / API Development
topics: RESTful API design principles (versioning, authentication, error handling)
Database design: relational vs. NoSQL, indexing, query optimization
Authentication & Authorization: JWT, OAuth 2.0, session management
Microservices architecture: service discovery, load balancing, circuit breakers
Message queues: RabbitMQ, Kafka, async processing patterns
Caching strategies: Redis, CDN, application-level caching
Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes basics
CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies
Security: SQL injection, rate limiting, input validation
Logging, monitoring, and observability (Prometheus, Grafana)
common_question_patterns: How do you design a scalable REST API?
Explain database indexing and when you would use a composite index.
How would you handle high traffic spikes in a backend service?
What's the difference between horizontal and vertical scaling?

domains.name: Full-Stack Software Engineering
topics: System design: designing scalable, maintainable systems end-to-end
API design and frontend-backend integration patterns
Database selection and schema design
Authentication flows (OAuth, JWT, session cookies)
Performance optimization at each layer (frontend, backend, database)
Deployment architectures: cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), serverless, containers
Testing strategy: unit, integration, and E2E testing
Code quality: code reviews, refactoring, SOLID principles
Version control workflows (Git branching strategies)
Agile/Scrum development practices
common_question_patterns: Design a simple URL shortener service from scratch.
How do you decide when to use a SQL vs NoSQL database?
Walk me through how you would architect a new feature end-to-end.
How do you approach debugging a performance issue in production?

domains.name: Data Science / Machine Learning
topics: Supervised vs. unsupervised learning: algorithms, use cases, trade-offs
Model evaluation: precision/recall, ROC-AUC, cross-validation, overfitting
Feature engineering: encoding, normalization, handling missing data
Deep learning: neural network architectures, backpropagation, regularization
Large Language Models: fine-tuning, RAG, prompt engineering
Data pipelines: ETL, data cleaning, pandas/PySpark
Statistics: hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, A/B testing
MLOps: model deployment, monitoring, drift detection, MLflow
SQL for data analysis: window functions, CTEs, aggregations
Experiment design and causal inference
common_question_patterns: How would you handle a highly imbalanced dataset?
Explain the bias-variance trade-off.
How do you detect and handle data drift in a deployed model?
Walk me through how you would design an A/B test for a new feature.

domains.name: Data Engineering
topics: Data pipeline architecture: batch vs. streaming (Spark, Kafka, Flink)
Data warehouse design: star schema, snowflake schema, dimensional modeling
ETL vs. ELT: when to use each, tools (dbt, Airbyte, Fivetran)
Data quality: validation, testing, monitoring pipelines
SQL optimization for large datasets: partitioning, clustering
Cloud data platforms: BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, Azure Synapse
Orchestration: Apache Airflow, Dagster, Prefect
Data governance: lineage, cataloging, access control
API integration and data ingestion patterns
Infrastructure as code for data (Terraform, CloudFormation)
common_question_patterns: How would you design a real-time data pipeline for event tracking?
What's the difference between a data lake and a data warehouse?
How do you ensure data quality in an automated pipeline?
Explain partitioning strategies in distributed storage systems.

domains.name: Product Management
topics: Product discovery: user research, problem framing, opportunity sizing
Prioritization frameworks: RICE, MoSCoW, value vs. effort matrix
Metrics and KPIs: defining success, funnel analysis, cohort analysis
Roadmap planning: stakeholder alignment, quarterly planning
Agile methodologies: sprint planning, backlog grooming, user stories
A/B testing and experimentation culture
Competitive analysis and market positioning
Technical literacy: working with engineering teams, API/system understanding
Go-to-market strategy and launch planning
Customer feedback loops: NPS, interviews, usability testing
common_question_patterns: How do you decide what to build next when resources are limited?
Tell me about a product decision you made with incomplete data.
How do you handle conflicting priorities from different stakeholders?
How would you measure the success of a new feature after launch?

domains.name: Business Consulting / Strategy
topics: Structured problem solving: MECE principle, issue trees
Business frameworks: Porter's Five Forces, BCG matrix, SWOT
Market sizing and estimation (Fermi problems)
Case interview structure: problem framing, hypothesis-driven approach
Financial literacy: P&L, EBITDA, NPV, ROI analysis
Slide-based communication: pyramid principle, executive summaries
Change management and organizational transformation
Industry knowledge: relevant sectors in Germany (automotive, manufacturing, fintech)
Client management and stakeholder engagement
Data-driven storytelling and recommendation synthesis
common_question_patterns: How would you approach sizing the market for electric vehicles in Germany?
A client's profitability is declining — how do you diagnose the issue?
How do you structure a recommendation when you have conflicting data?
What would you advise a traditional German Mittelstand company entering a new market?

domains.name: Finance / Controlling
topics: Financial statement analysis: income statement, balance sheet, cash flow
Valuation methods: DCF, comparable company analysis, precedent transactions
Financial modeling: Excel/Python-based models, scenario analysis
Risk management: market risk, credit risk, operational risk
Budgeting and forecasting: rolling forecasts, variance analysis
KPIs in finance: EBITDA, working capital, free cash flow, WACC
German accounting standards: HGB vs. IFRS differences
Controlling in German companies: cost center analysis, contribution margins
Investment appraisal: NPV, IRR, payback period
Regulatory compliance: MiFID II, Basel III (for banking roles)
common_question_patterns: Walk me through how you would value a mid-sized German company.
What's the difference between EBITDA and free cash flow?
How would you build a three-statement financial model?
What are the key differences between HGB and IFRS accounting?

domains.name: Mechanical / Automotive Engineering
topics: CAD/CAE tools: CATIA, SolidWorks, ANSYS, Simulink
FEM analysis and structural simulation
Thermodynamics and fluid mechanics fundamentals
Manufacturing processes: CNC, additive manufacturing, injection molding
Automotive systems: powertrain, chassis, ADAS, electrification (EV/HEV)
Quality management: FMEA, 8D, ISO 9001, IATF 16949
Project management in engineering: Gantt charts, milestone planning
Materials science: fatigue, stress-strain, material selection
Systems engineering and requirements management
Sustainability and Lifecycle Assessment (LCA)
common_question_patterns: How would you approach a structural failure analysis?
Explain the difference between static and dynamic loading in mechanical design.
How do you apply FMEA in a product development process?
What are the main engineering challenges in developing electric vehicle powertrains?

domains.name: Marketing & Growth
topics: Digital marketing channels: SEO, SEA, social media, email, content
Marketing analytics: attribution models, CLV, CAC, ROAS
Campaign management: A/B testing, audience segmentation, personalization
Brand strategy and positioning in the German market
CRM and marketing automation (Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo)
Performance marketing: Google Ads, Meta Ads, programmatic
Content strategy: SEO-driven content, editorial calendars
Market research: qualitative and quantitative methods
Growth hacking techniques and product-led growth
Privacy regulations affecting marketing: GDPR implications
common_question_patterns: How do you measure the ROI of a brand awareness campaign?
What's your approach to setting up a new digital marketing channel?
How do you balance short-term performance metrics with long-term brand building?
What GDPR considerations would you apply to an email marketing campaign?
